name: Dumbbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent and a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and guide the dumbbells close to your legs without changing your knee angle.
Descend until you feel a strong stretch along your hamstrings without rounding your lower back.
Squeeze your glutes and hamstrings to drive your hips forward and stand back upright.
tips: Keep the dumbbells close to your shins rather than letting them drift forward away from your center of gravity.
Stop the descent as soon as your pelvis starts to tuck under or your spine begins to round.
